fact: CNEDOGE issues national identity documents (DIP) carrying a biometric security system, with an unwritten norm of about 30 working days per document.
source_slug: 2024-01-01 On the functioning of Equatorial Guinea's National Centre for the Issuance of Official Documents (CNEDOGE)

fact: The Equatorial Guinea press office reports that CNEDOGE, the national centre issuing identity documents and passports, runs technology largely installed in 2017-2018, which the Vice-President ordered modernised.
